name: foodbridge
description: FoodBridge — food donation, pickup and delivery platform (React + Vite + Express + MongoDB)

scripts.install-all: npm --prefix backend install && npm --prefix frontend install
scripts.dev: bash -c 'npm --prefix backend run dev & npm --prefix frontend run dev & wait'
scripts.check: node --check backend/src/server.js && node --check backend/src/routes/auth.js && node --check backend/src/seed.js
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:edge && npm run test:journey
